entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Julius Buckler was a German First World War fighter ace credited with 36 victories during the war. He shot down 29 enemy airplanes and seven observation balloons; two other victories went unconfirmed. He was one of four German fighter aces to win Germany's highest decorations for valor for both enlisted man and officer.
